gvar glyph variations for variable TrueType outlines.

Parses the glyph variation data and computes per-point deltas for a glyph at normalized coordinates: tuple scalars (with intermediate regions, peak-zero axes skipped per the OT spec), packed point numbers and deltas (byte/word/long runs, shared tuples/points), plus IUP interpolation for untouched points. Phantom-point deltas are consumed but not applied to outlines (metric variations via HVAR/MVAR are a follow-up; see TODO in font.glyphExtents).

Malformed data fails the glyph's variation (base outline kept), never raises.

proc applyGvarDeltas(ctx: GvarContext; gid, numPoints: int;
                     ends: openArray[int]; xs, ys: var seq[int32]): bool {.
    ...raises: [], tags: [], forbids: [].}
Adds gvar deltas for gid to the flat outline points in place. Contours are delimited by ends (last index per contour) for IUP interpolation of untouched points. Returns false on malformed data, leaving xs/ys untouched; empty or missing variation data is a successful no-op.
